waterways.name: Taiwan Strait
waterways.note: Separates Taiwan from mainland China and carries a large share of container traffic between North Asia and the rest of the world.

waterways.name: Strait of Malacca
waterways.note: The shortest sea route between the Indian and Pacific Oceans, and the main crude oil corridor into East Asia.

waterways.name: Strait of Hormuz
waterways.note: The only sea route out of the Persian Gulf. Every barrel exported by Gulf producers without a pipeline passes through it.

waterways.name: Bosphorus Strait
waterways.note: The Black Sea outlet through Istanbul, governed by the Montreux Convention, and the route for Black Sea grain and crude.

waterways.name: Suez Canal
waterways.note: The Europe to Asia shortcut. Traffic diverted around the Cape of Good Hope adds roughly ten days to the voyage.

waterways.name: Panama Canal
waterways.note: Links the Atlantic and Pacific. Its locks depend on Gatun Lake rainfall, so drought directly reduces daily transits.

waterways.name: Strait of Gibraltar
waterways.note: The Atlantic entrance to the Mediterranean, and the naval approach to southern Europe and North Africa.

waterways.name: Bab el-Mandeb
waterways.note: The southern gate of the Red Sea. Closing it strands Suez traffic on the wrong side of the canal.

waterways.name: Dardanelles
waterways.note: The Aegean end of the Turkish Straits, paired with the Bosphorus on the Black Sea route.
